--- /dev/null
+++ b/.github/workflows/hushrun-bake.yml
@@ -0,0 +1,38 @@
+# hushrun: bakes the compiled code of main's build into an image that sandboxes and containers
+# start warm from (hushrun build bake). It runs after 'CI' passes on main, and by hand.
+# A Dockerfile takes the image with one line:
+#   COPY --from=ghcr.io/acme/shop:hushrun-linux-x64-latest /hushrun /hushrun
+name: hushrun bake
+on:
+  workflow_run:
+    workflows: ['CI']
+    branches: [main]
+    types: [completed]
+  workflow_dispatch:
+  # Daily, so that an image the re-bake limit held back catches up with main (B-73).
+  schedule:
+    - cron: '17 4 * * *'
+# One bake at a time: a later one never lands under an earlier one's tag.
+concurrency:
+  group: hushrun-bake
+  cancel-in-progress: false
+permissions:
+  contents: read
+  packages: write   # pushes the image to this repository's packages
+  id-token: write   # reads the build from hushrun's backend, and signs the image keylessly
+jobs:
+  bake:
+    # By hand on the default branch alone, or on the schedule (which GitHub runs on the default
+    # branch alone); after the build only for a push to it, in this repository (never a fork's
+    # pull request whose branch has the same name).
+    if: (github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && github.ref == format('refs/heads/{0}', github.event.repository.default_branch)) || github.event_name == 'schedule' || (github.event.workflow_run.conclusion == 'success' && github.event.workflow_run.event == 'push' && github.event.workflow_run.head_repository.full_name == github.repository)
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    steps:
+      # The whole history: the bake builds only a commit that comes after the backend's newest
+      # build (B-75), which a shallow checkout can't tell.
+      - uses: actions/checkout@v5
+        with:
+          fetch-depth: 0
+      - run: npx --yes hushrun@^<version> build bake --from backend --trusted --oci ghcr.io/acme/shop
+        env:
+          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}

--- /dev/null
+++ b/hushrun.yaml
@@ -0,0 +1,4 @@
+# hushrun.yaml: where this repository's events go.
+version: 1
+repository: github.com/acme/shop
+backend: <your org's URL, once you sign in>

notes: your org: connects github.com/acme/shop, so that its CI records results with its own ID token
your org: adds github.com/acme/shop to your org's dashboard, unless it is there already
hushrun.yaml: a new file: repository github.com/acme/shop, its URL on hushrun, and the key that verifies hushrun's log
A Dockerfile takes the baked image with: COPY --from=ghcr.io/acme/shop:hushrun-linux-x64-latest /hushrun /hushrun

Blocks bound to the build's folders (C -sys crates, build scripts, what depends on them) are baked too, at the paths of GitHub's runner: a sandbox reuses them only where HOME=/home/runner, CARGO_HOME=/home/runner/.cargo and the checkout is /home/runner/work/shop/shop (the image's baked.json names them, B-76); elsewhere they compile

Before CI's first build is baked, `hushrun build bake --deps-only --oci <image> -- <the check's cargo command>` in a job on the default branch publishes an image of the dependencies alone (a `cargo test` compiles its tests and runs none, the repository's own crates as stubs); the first full bake replaces it. `--report -- <command>` on any bake measures that command cold and from the image, on the machine it runs on

Change by hand: to let a run trust the baked image's signature with no backend, add to hushrun.yaml:
  build:
    baked:
      signers:
        - issuer: https://token.actions.githubusercontent.com
          subject: https://github.com/acme/shop/.github/workflows/hushrun-bake.yml@refs/heads/main
